findings.source: Bald: Я тут до этого с ма и ба жил, да нас коллекторы выгнали из квартиры. История просто пиздец. Если впустишь, расскажу как-нибудь.
findings.currentTarget: Bald: Hapo awali nilikuwa nikiishi hapa na mama na baba, lakini wadai wa madeni walitufukuza katika nyumba yetu. Ni hadithi mbaya sana. Ukiniruhusu niingie, nitakusimulia siku nyingine.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Bald: Hapo awali nilikuwa nikiishi hapa na mama na bibi, lakini wadai wa madeni walitufukuza katika nyumba yetu. Ni hadithi mbaya sana. Ukiniruhusu niingie, nitakusimulia siku nyingine.
findings.objectiveReason: The source colloquial ма и ба means mother and grandmother, confirmed explicitly by approved theater-man meaning aliyeishi na mama na bibi yake. baba changes the grandmother into the father. Preserve all remaining facts and voice.
